cohort: Women of reproductive age (n=9134, aged 15-49 years) in Pakistan
finding: Women from the Punjab region, those who delivered by caesarean section, and those who reported complications during pregnancy were more likely to develop obstetric fistula.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by caesarean section were more likely to develop obstetric fistula (OR = 1.91, 95% CI = 1.06-3.42).
